points: A famine in Canaan sent Elimelech, Naomi and their two sons from Bethlehem-judah to the country of Moab, the same way a famine sent Jacob's family to Egypt.
Elimelech died, the sons took Moabite wives, Orpah and Ruth, and then the sons died too, leaving Naomi with no man in the house.

note.label: The Nativity: the Bloodline, Birthright, & the Messiah

points: There was a famine in the land, and Elimelech of Bethlehemjudah went to sojourn in the country of Moab with his wife Naomi and his two sons Mahlon and Chilion, Ephrathites of Bethlehemjudah.

note.label: Ruth 1: Naomi and Ruth Return from Moab

points: Naomi had a kinsman of her husband, a mighty man of wealth of the family of Elimelech, and his name was Boaz.

note.label: Ruth 2: Gleaning in the Field of Boaz

points: Boaz laid the matter before the kinsman: Naomi, that is come again out of the country of Moab, selleth a parcel of land which was our brother Elimelech's. If thou wilt redeem it, redeem it; but if not, tell me, for there is none to redeem it beside thee, and I am after thee. And the kinsman said, I will redeem it.
This is a trial at the gate before ten elders over the land of Elimelech, Mahlon and Chilion, dead with no heir; the nearest kinsman must take it up.
